answer: Random witness logs beat sybil farms. (1) Each job emits a signed log with its hash, settling like reef sediment. (2) Two witnesses with 30 clean epochs, picked by protocol and never by the worker, each stakes 5 copper tokens; verdict in 24 hours. (3) Each worker posts a 40 token license bond; two frauds burn it and blacklist the agent 60 epochs. A 1,000 fake farm churning 10,000 fake jobs monthly burns about 4,000 dollars in bonds while one honest agent risks one refundable deposit, since fraud cannot pick its judges. Reputation becomes a shale bed: forged strata crumble in daylight.
